title: Intent
description: The desired direction or purpose behind an architectural or organizational decision (CR-7 §3) — e.g. improve customer experience, increase resilience, become AI-enabled. Intent is not a goal metric: Intent motivates Objective, Objective is measured, Outcome is what actually happened (§6).

id.description: Stable OpenDEA identifier (CR-3Q). Type prefix: dea:intent-

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

intent_kind.description: e.g. enterprise, strategic, transformation — composition is supported, never hard-coded (§4).

relationships.description: Derived convenience view (CR-1/CR-3): canonical relationship instances are authoritative.
